Definition: of uncertain affinity; here; used also imperative hither!; and of time, hitherto:--come (hither), hither(-to).
BiblicalUsage: Come hither is a call to draw near, and it is spoken at the turning points of the Gospels. Jesus calls Lazarus out of the tomb, He calls the rich young ruler to follow, and the angel calls John to see the bride of the Lamb.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the call to come is the heart of the gospel. Jesus does not wait for us to find our own way to Him; He calls us by name, and the dead hear His voice and live.
